name: Utsusemi
source:
Our guy trains with a famous author. As a test for him, he is sent to gather info from a performance group, with the author's daughter tagging alone. There seem to be rumors about how this group gets their donations. If he can chase one girl per chapter, he will find out what this all has to do with a big fire 18 years ago. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公跟随一位著名作家学习。作为考验，作家让他前去调查某个表演团体，还叫女儿随行。这个团体募集捐款的方式似乎流传着一些不好的传闻。每章追查一名女孩的故事后，他将逐步弄清这一切与18年前那场大火有何关联。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
